title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-11 06:06:20 最新章节：第1934章 陈稳的实力你这徒弟太夸张了
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
玄黄星域下，万族林立，各大道统竞相争锋。
荒古界，天命帝族，陈族！
“十六年了，也不知小稳过得好不好。”
一位气质高贵，样貌绝丽的中年女子愁脸满面地自怨自艾着。
这时，一位身材高大，气宇不凡的男子轻轻拍了拍女子的肩膀，“夫人，其实……”
陈霸道才刚开口，叶沉雁便猛然转头，又气又怒道：“其实什么，又想拿你那一套来搪塞我吗。”
“我……”
见陈霸道还要想辩解，叶沉雁顿时更怒了。
“我什么我，如果不是你没用，我们母子能分离十六年，至今都难见上一面？”
“堂堂一帝族族长，连自己的儿子都保不住，你说说你有什么用，有什么用！”
说到最后，叶沉雁有些歇斯底里起来。
“呜呜呜……”
看着发泄一通后便低声呜咽起来的妻子，陈霸道默默地将其揽在怀里。
陈霸道双目平静，但却含着万重惊雷，仿佛也在压抑着滔天怒火。
这事其实得从十六年说起。
他们的小儿子陈稳在出世时，便迎来了命劫。
那一场劫雷荡尽亿万里，引来了诸多禁忌异象。
命劫于这个世界中并不是一件好事，相传这种劫命之子成长起来，必会带来灭世灾难。
尤其是他们身为天命帝族，本就传承于天命，受益于天地庇护。
后来，这动静也引起了各大势力和道统的注意。

于时在第一时间，要求他们处死陈稳。
虎毒都尚不吃儿，更何况是人。
陈族在陈霸道的坚持下，还是通过各方面的争取，从而救下了陈稳。
但相应的，陈稳必须要下放到下界，还必须受到监管。
而他们陈族，虽然可以确保陈稳安稳地过完这一生，但绝对不能提供任何形式上的支持。
各种思绪于陈霸道心头闪过，半晌才道，“夫人，你放心好了，有我在小稳绝对没事的。”
“最好这样，如果小稳有一点事，我绝对不会原谅你的。”叶沉雁恨恨道。
“好了好了，小稳那里的情况全在我掌控之中，如果有事早就有人来通报了，放心吧。”
陈霸道轻笑地拍了拍叶沉雁的肩膀。
“族长不好了，不好了！”就在这时，一道急促的声音响起。
陈霸这下笑不出来了，叶沉雁也猛然抬起来，双目猩红不已。
来人叫陈奴，是专门关注陈稳情况的人。
如今陈奴这番样子，就不得不让他们多想了。
陈霸道拍了拍叶沉雁的肩膀，安慰道，“一定没事的，放心。”
陈奴浑身直震不止。
陈霸道这个表情才是最可怕的。
“说，什么情况。”陈霸道抬头看向陈奴，眼底肆虐着亿万惊雷。
“回族长，小少主他他他的魂牌裂了！”陈奴压低身体，颤声道。
“你说什么！”
content_en:
Under the Xuanhuang Star Territory, there are thousands of races, and all major avenues are competing for the upper hand.
In the ancient world, the Tianming Imperial Clan, the Chen Clan!
"It's been sixteen years, and I don't know if Xiaowen is doing well."
A middle-aged woman with noble temperament and stunning appearance was looking sad and feeling sorry for herself.
At this time, a tall and imposing man gently patted the woman on the shoulder, "Madam, actually..."
As soon as Chen Ba Dao spoke, Ye Chenyan suddenly turned his head and said angrily: "Actually, what are you trying to do to me again?"
"I..."
Seeing that Chen Ba Dao still wanted to defend himself, Ye Chenyan suddenly became even more angry.
"What am I? If it weren't for your uselessness, our mother and son could have been separated for sixteen years and still hardly see each other?"
"The majestic patriarch of the Imperial Clan can't even protect his own son. Tell me what use you have, what use you have!"
At the end of the sentence, Ye Chenyan became a little hysterical.
"Woooooooo..."
Looking at his wife who was sobbing softly after venting her anger, Chen Badao silently held her in his arms.
Chen Badao's eyes were calm, but they were full of thunder, as if he was also suppressing the overwhelming anger.
This matter actually has to start from the sixteenth year.
When their youngest son Chen Wen was born, he faced a fateful disaster.
That tribulation thunder spread across hundreds of millions of miles, causing many taboo visions.
Destiny is not a good thing in this world. According to legend, if a child of this kind of fate grows up, it will definitely bring disaster to the world.
Especially since they are members of the Tianming Imperial Clan, they have inherited Tianming and benefit from the protection of heaven and earth.
Later, this movement also attracted the attention of major forces and orthodoxies.
Yu Shi immediately asked them to execute Chen Wen.
Even tiger venom is not edible, let alone humans.
Under Chen BaDao's insistence, the Chen clan managed to save Chen Wen through various efforts.
But correspondingly, Chen Wen must be sent to the lower realm and must be supervised.
As for the Chen clan, although they can ensure that Chen can live his life safely, they absolutely cannot provide any form of support.
Various thoughts flashed through Chen Badao's mind, and he said after a while, "Madam, don't worry, Xiaowen will be fine with me."
"It's best this way. If anything happens to Xiao Wen, I will never forgive you." Ye Chenyan said bitterly.
"Okay, okay, the situation at Xiaowen's place is all under my control. If anything happens, someone will have reported it already. Don't worry."
Chen Badao chuckled and patted Ye Chenyan on the shoulder.
"The patriarch is in trouble, he's in trouble!" At this moment, a rapid voice sounded.
Chen Ba couldn't laugh anymore, and Ye Chenyan suddenly raised his head, his eyes filled with scarlet red.
The person who came was called Chen Nu, who was specifically concerned about Chen Wen's situation.
Now that Chen Nu was acting like this, they had to think more.
Chen Badao patted Ye Chenyan's shoulder and comforted him, "It will be fine, don't worry."
Chen Nu was shocked all over.
Chen Badao's expression was the scariest.
"Tell me what's going on." Chen Badao raised his head and looked at Chen Nu, with billions of thunder raging in his eyes.
"Hui Clan Chief, the young master's soul card is cracked!" Chen Nu lowered his body and said in a trembling voice.
"What did you say!"
